questions.stem: It was ____ hot that we stayed inside all day.
choices: so
such
very
too
much
questions.why: 뒤에 형용사 hot만 있으므로 「so + 형용사 + that」 형태를 쓴다. such는 뒤에 명사가 있어야 하고, very·too·much는 that절과 짝을 이루지 못한다.

questions.stem: She spoke slowly ____ that everyone could understand her.
choices: so
such
very
too
as
questions.why: ‘~하기 위해서’라는 목적은 「so that + 주어 + can/could」로 나타낸다. such는 명사와 함께 쓰는 말이다.

questions.stem: He is ____ a kind boy that everyone likes him.
choices: so
such
very
too
quite
questions.why: 뒤에 「a + 형용사 + 명사」가 오므로 such를 쓴다. so는 형용사·부사 앞에만 쓴다.

questions.stem: I got up early ____ that I could catch the first bus.
choices: so
such
too
very
and
questions.why: 목적을 나타내는 「so that + 주어 + could + 동사원형」이다. 나머지는 that절을 이끌 수 없다.

questions.stem: The soup was so salty ____ I couldn't eat it.
choices: that
what
which
than
so
questions.why: 「so + 형용사 + that + 주어 + 동사」로 결과를 나타내므로 that이 알맞다.

questions.stem: Please turn off your phone ____ you can focus on the movie.
choices: so that
such that
so as
in order
that so
questions.why: 뒤에 「주어 + can + 동사원형」의 절이 오므로 목적을 나타내는 접속사 so that을 쓴다. so as 뒤에는 to부정사가 온다.

questions.stem: He studied hard ____ pass the entrance exam.
choices: so that
in order to
so as
such as
in order
questions.why: 뒤에 동사원형 pass가 바로 오므로 「in order to + 동사원형」이 알맞다. so that과 in order 뒤에는 절이 와야 한다.

questions.stem: It was such ____ interesting book that I read it twice.
choices: a
an
the
one
so
questions.why: such 뒤에는 「a(n) + 형용사 + 명사」가 오는데 interesting이 모음 소리로 시작하므로 an을 쓴다.

questions.stem: She was ____ tired that she fell asleep on the sofa.
choices: so
such
such a
quite
too
questions.why: 형용사 tired 앞이므로 so를 쓴다. such·such a는 명사가 필요하고 too는 that절과 함께 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem: There were ____ many people at the concert that I couldn't see the stage.
choices: so
such
very
too
much
questions.why: 「so many + 복수명사 + that」의 형태이다. such는 many와 함께 쓰지 않고, much는 셀 수 없는 명사에 쓴다.

questions.stem: I had ____ much homework that I stayed up until midnight.
choices: so
such
many
very
too
questions.why: 「so much + 셀 수 없는 명사 + that」의 형태이다. many는 셀 수 있는 명사에 쓴다.

questions.stem: He wore a thick coat so ____ to keep warm.
choices: as
that
than
of
for
questions.why: ‘~하기 위해서’를 뜻하는 「so as to + 동사원형」이다.

questions.stem: The movie was ____ boring that I fell asleep in the middle.
choices: so
such
such a
very
too
questions.why: 형용사 boring 앞이므로 so가 알맞다. 명사가 없으므로 such 계열은 쓸 수 없다.

questions.stem: Kate turned on the light ____ she could read her book.
choices: so that
such that
so as
so as to
in order
questions.why: 뒤에 「주어 + could + 동사원형」 절이 오므로 목적의 so that을 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장의 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말은? (1) It was ____ cold that the lake froze. (2) He ran ____ fast that no one could catch him.
choices: so
such
very
too
that
questions.why: (1)은 형용사 cold, (2)는 부사 fast 앞이므로 둘 다 「so + 형용사/부사 + that」의 so를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장의 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말은? (1) He is ____ a good singer that everyone loves him. (2) It was ____ an exciting game that we shouted a lot.
choices: so
such
very
too
quite
questions.why: 두 문장 모두 「a(n) + 형용사 + 명사」가 뒤따르므로 such를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장의 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말은? (1) I left early ____ that I could avoid the traffic. (2) Speak louder ____ that we can hear you.
choices: so
such
very
too
as
questions.why: 두 문장 모두 목적을 나타내는 so that이 필요하므로 so를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은? (A) It was ____ a long day that I was exhausted. (B) The tea was ____ hot that I burned my tongue.
choices: such – so
so – such
such – such
so – so
very – so
questions.why: (A)는 「a + 형용사 + 명사」 앞이므로 such, (B)는 형용사 hot 앞이므로 so를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은? (A) He exercises every day ____ that he can stay healthy. (B) She was ____ nervous that her hands were shaking.
choices: so – so
so – such
such – so
such – such
as – so
questions.why: (A)는 목적의 so that, (B)는 「so + 형용사 + that」이므로 둘 다 so이다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은? (A) We took a taxi ____ order to arrive on time. (B) He shouted ____ that we could hear him.
choices: in – so
in – such
for – so
to – so
in – as
questions.why: (A)는 「in order to + 동사원형」, (B)는 목적의 so that이므로 in – so가 알맞다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장의 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말은? (1) The bag was ____ heavy that I could not carry it. (2) There was ____ much snow that the school closed.
choices: so
such
very
too
many
questions.why: (1)은 「so + 형용사 + that」, (2)는 「so much + 셀 수 없는 명사 + that」으로 둘 다 so를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: It was ____ a nice day that we went for a walk.
He is ____ a fast runner that nobody can beat him.
She was ____ kind that everyone smiled at her.
It was ____ a boring class that I yawned.
They were ____ good friends that they shared everything.
questions.why: ③은 형용사 kind 앞이므로 so, 나머지는 모두 명사구 앞이므로 such가 들어간다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: It was so a nice day that we went out.
He is such tall that he can touch the ceiling.
I ran fast so that I could catch the bus.
She got up early in order that catch the train.
The tea was too hot that I couldn't drink it.
questions.why: ③은 「so that + 주어 + could + 동사원형」의 바른 목적 표현이다. ①은 such a, ②는 so tall, ④는 in order to catch, ⑤는 so hot that으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: He spoke so quietly that I couldn't hear him.
It was such a long movie that I fell asleep.
I studied hard so that I could pass the test.
She was so kind girl that everyone liked her.
We hurried in order to arrive on time.
questions.why: ④는 뒤에 「형용사 + 명사」가 오므로 so가 아니라 such a kind girl로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 것은?
choices: The box was such heavy that I couldn't lift it.
He left early so as he could catch the 7 o'clock train.
We saved money so as to buying a car.
It was such an old house that nobody lived in it.
She spoke so slow that I understood her easily.
questions.why: ④는 「such + a + 형용사 + 명사 + that」의 바른 형태이다. ①은 so heavy, ②는 so that he could catch, ③은 so as to buy, ⑤는 so slowly로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 것은?
choices: I wrote it down so that I wouldn't forget it.
There was so much noise that I couldn't sleep.
He is such a good cook that his food is famous.
She was so a busy woman that she had no free time.
They practiced hard so that they could win.
questions.why: ④는 「a + 형용사 + 명사」 앞이므로 so가 아니라 such a busy woman으로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 바른 것은?
choices: It was so cold that the lake froze.
He is so a smart student that he solves any problem.
I turned on the light so that read a book.
The bag was such expensive that I didn't buy it.
We left early so as we could get good seats.
questions.why: ①은 「so + 형용사 + that + 주어 + 동사」로 바르다. ②는 such a, ③은 so that I could read, ④는 so expensive, ⑤는 so that we could로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 것은?
choices: She sang so beautifully that everyone clapped.
It was such nice weather that we had a picnic.
He exercises every day so that he can stay healthy.
I whispered so that not wake the baby.
The question was so difficult that nobody answered it.
questions.why: ④의 so that 뒤에는 「주어 + 동사」가 와야 하므로 so that I would not wake the baby로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법에 맞는 것은?
choices: I closed the window so that the noise wouldn't come in.
He was such tired that he went to bed early.
It was so an exciting match that we screamed.
She studies hard in order to she can be a doctor.
The coffee was so hot for me to drink.
questions.why: ①은 목적의 so that 절이 바르게 쓰였다. ②는 so tired, ③은 such an exciting match, ④는 in order that she can, ⑤는 too hot으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법에 맞지 않는 것은?
choices: They were so hungry that they ate everything.
It was such a small room that only one bed fit in it.
We took an umbrella so that we would not get wet.
He spoke so fast that I missed half of it.
The music was such loud that I covered my ears.
questions.why: ⑤는 형용사 loud 앞이므로 such가 아니라 so loud that으로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: It was <u>so</u> windy that we went home early.
He is <u>such</u> a good friend that I trust him.
She was <u>so</u> a lucky girl that she won twice.
I ate <u>so</u> much that I felt sick.
We spoke quietly <u>so that</u> the baby could sleep.
questions.why: ③은 「a + 형용사 + 명사」 앞이므로 so를 such로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 것은?
choices: He ran <u>so as to</u> catch the bus.
She was so busy <u>that</u> she skipped lunch.
It was such <u>a</u> hot day that we went swimming.
I studied <u>in order to</u> get good grades.
There were <u>such</u> many people that I got lost.
questions.why: ⑤는 many 앞이므로 such가 아니라 so many people that으로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 바르지 않은 것은?
choices: The story was <u>so</u> sad that I cried.
He left early <u>so that</u> he could avoid traffic.
It was <u>such an</u> easy test that everyone passed.
She spoke <u>so slow</u> that we all understood her.
We saved money <u>in order to</u> travel abroad.
questions.why: ④는 동사 spoke를 꾸미는 부사가 필요하므로 so slowly로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 각 문장의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
choices: I was <u>so</u> excited that I couldn't sleep.
It was such <u>a</u> beautiful song that I cried.
He shouted <u>so that</u> everyone could hear him.
We hurried <u>so as</u> arrive on time.
There was <u>so</u> much rain that the road flooded.
questions.why: ④는 so as 뒤에 to가 빠졌다. so as to arrive로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법에 맞지 않는 것은?
choices: The bag was <u>so</u> heavy that I couldn't carry it.
She is <u>such</u> a kind nurse that patients love her.
I wore a mask <u>so that</u> I wouldn't catch a cold.
It was <u>such</u> cold that we stayed in.
He practiced <u>in order to</u> win the contest.
questions.why: ④는 형용사 cold만 있으므로 such가 아니라 so cold that으로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
choices: He was <u>so</u> angry that he shouted at us.
They walked quietly <u>so that</u> nobody would wake up.
It was such <u>an</u> useful book that I bought two.
The soup was <u>so</u> hot that I burned my tongue.
She left early <u>in order to</u> see the doctor.
questions.why: useful은 [j] 소리로 시작하므로 such a useful book이 맞다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 그 상자는 너무 무거워서 나는 그것을 들 수 없었다.
choices: The box was such heavy that I couldn't lift it.
The box was so heavy that I couldn't lift it.
The box was so heavy so that I couldn't lift it.
The box was too heavy that I couldn't lift it.
The box was very heavy that I couldn't lift it.
questions.why: ‘너무 ~해서 …하다’는 「so + 형용사 + that + 주어 + 동사」로 쓴다. such·too·very는 이 구조에 쓸 수 없다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 나는 첫 기차를 타기 위해 일찍 일어났다.
choices: I got up early so that I could catch the first train.
I got up early so that catch the first train.
I got up early in order that catch the first train.
I got up early so as catch the first train.
I got up early such that I could catch the first train.
questions.why: 목적은 「so that + 주어 + could + 동사원형」으로 나타낸다. ②③은 절에 주어와 조동사가 없고 ④는 so as to가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 그것은 아주 재미있는 영화여서 나는 그것을 두 번 봤다.
choices: It was so an interesting movie that I watched it twice.
It was such interesting movie that I watched it twice.
It was such an interesting movie that I watched it twice.
It was so interesting movie that I watched it twice.
It was very an interesting movie that I watched it twice.
questions.why: 「such + a(n) + 형용사 + 명사 + that」이 바른 어순이다. so는 형용사·부사만 꾸민다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 그는 감기에 걸리지 않도록 코트를 입었다.
choices: He wore a coat so that he would not catch a cold.
He wore a coat so that he not catch a cold.
He wore a coat such that he would not catch a cold.
He wore a coat so as he would not catch a cold.
He wore a coat in order that not catch a cold.
questions.why: ‘~하지 않도록’은 「so that + 주어 + would not + 동사원형」으로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 날씨가 너무 추워서 우리는 밖에 나갈 수 없었다.
choices: It was such cold that we couldn't go out.
It was so cold that we couldn't go out.
It was too cold that we couldn't go out.
It was so cold so that we couldn't go out.
It was such a cold that we couldn't go out.
questions.why: 형용사 cold 앞에는 so를 쓰고 뒤에 that절이 이어진다. too는 that절이 아니라 to부정사와 짝을 이룬다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 그녀는 살을 빼기 위해 매일 운동한다.
choices: She exercises every day in order to lose weight.
She exercises every day in order lose weight.
She exercises every day so as lose weight.
She exercises every day so that lose weight.
She exercises every day for lose weight.
questions.why: 「in order to + 동사원형」이 ‘~하기 위해서’를 뜻한다. ③은 so as to, ④는 so that 뒤에 주어와 조동사가 필요하다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 의미가 같은 것은? He left early in order to avoid the traffic.
choices: He left early so that he could avoid the traffic.
He left early so that the traffic could avoid him.
He left early so as he avoided the traffic.
He left early such that he avoided the traffic.
He left early so early that he avoided the traffic.
questions.why: 「in order to + 동사원형」은 「so that + 주어 + could + 동사원형」으로 바꿔 쓸 수 있다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 의미가 같은 것은? The box was too heavy for me to move.
choices: The box was so heavy that I could move it.
The box was so heavy that I couldn't move it.
The box was such heavy that I couldn't move it.
The box was so heavy that I moved it easily.
The box was heavy enough for me to move.
questions.why: 「too + 형용사 + for A + to부정사」는 「so + 형용사 + that + A + can't[couldn't]」로 바꿔 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 의미가 같은 것은? He is strong enough to carry the desk alone.
choices: He is so strong that he can carry the desk alone.
He is so strong that he can't carry the desk alone.
He is such strong that he can carry the desk alone.
He is too strong to carry the desk alone.
He is so a strong man that he carries the desk alone.
questions.why: 「형용사 + enough + to부정사」는 「so + 형용사 + that + 주어 + can」으로 바꿔 쓸 수 있다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 의미가 같은 것은? She studied hard so that she could enter the university.
choices: She studied hard in order to enter the university.
She studied hard in order that enter the university.
She studied hard so as enter the university.
She studied hard so hard that she entered the university.
She studied hard such that entering the university.
questions.why: 목적의 so that절은 「in order to + 동사원형」으로 바꿔 쓸 수 있다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 의미가 같은 것은? It was such a long book that I couldn't finish it.
choices: The book was so long that I couldn't finish it.
The book was so a long that I couldn't finish it.
The book was such long that I couldn't finish it.
The book was long enough for me to finish.
The book was not long enough for me to finish.
questions.why: 「such + a(n) + 형용사 + 명사」는 명사를 주어로 옮기면 「so + 형용사」가 된다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 의미가 같은 것은? I whispered so that the baby would not wake up.
choices: I whispered in order not to wake the baby up.
I whispered in order to wake the baby up.
I whispered so as to wake up the baby.
I whispered so quietly that the baby woke up.
I whispered such that the baby woke up.
questions.why: ‘~하지 않도록’의 so that ... not은 「in order not to + 동사원형」으로 바꿔 쓸 수 있다.

questions.stem: 다음 괄호 안에서 알맞은 것을 고르시오. It was (so, such) a windy day that the old tree fell down.
questions.why: 뒤에 「a + 형용사 + 명사」가 오므로 such를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 괄호 안에서 알맞은 것을 고르시오. The room was (so, such) dark that I turned on the light.
questions.why: 형용사 dark만 뒤따르므로 「so + 형용사 + that」의 so를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 괄호 안에서 알맞은 것을 고르시오. I ran fast (so that, so as) I could catch the bus.
questions.why: 뒤에 「주어 + could + 동사원형」 절이 오므로 so that을 쓴다. so as 뒤에는 to부정사가 온다.

questions.stem: 다음 괄호 안에서 알맞은 것을 고르시오. He saved money (in order to, in order that) buy a new bike.
questions.why: 뒤에 동사원형 buy가 바로 오므로 in order to를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 괄호 안에서 알맞은 것을 고르시오. There was (so, such) much rain that the river rose quickly.
questions.why: 「so much + 셀 수 없는 명사 + that」의 형태이다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 한 단어를 쓰시오. He spoke ____ loudly that everyone in the hall heard him.
questions.why: 부사 loudly 앞이므로 「so + 부사 + that」의 so를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 한 단어를 쓰시오. She is ____ a good dancer that she won first prize.
questions.why: 「a + 형용사 + 명사」 앞이므로 such를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 한 단어를 쓰시오. I left home early ____ that I could get a good seat.
questions.why: 목적을 나타내는 so that의 so가 들어간다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 세 단어를 쓰시오. (in으로 시작할 것) We took a taxi ____ arrive on time. (제시간에 도착하기 위해)
questions.why: ‘~하기 위해서’는 「in order to + 동사원형」으로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고치시오. It was <u>so</u> a cold night that we stayed home.
questions.why: 뒤에 「a + 형용사 + 명사」가 오므로 so를 such로 고친다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고치시오. He is <u>such</u> tall that he can reach the top shelf.
questions.why: 형용사 tall만 뒤따르므로 such를 so로 고친다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 두 단어로 고치시오. Yesterday I got up early so that I <u>catch</u> the first bus.
questions.why: 목적의 so that절에는 조동사를 함께 쓰며, 주절이 과거(got up)이므로 could catch로 고친다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고치시오. She studied hard <u>so as</u> pass the exam.
questions.why: so as 뒤에는 to부정사가 와야 하므로 so as to로 고친다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고치시오. The bag was so heavy <u>what</u> I couldn't carry it.
questions.why: 「so + 형용사 + that + 주어 + 동사」 구조이므로 what을 that으로 고친다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고치시오. There were <u>such</u> many stars that we couldn't count them.
questions.why: many 앞에는 such가 아니라 so를 써서 so many ~ that의 형태로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 한 단어를 쓰시오. The tea was too hot for me to drink. = The tea was so hot that I ____ drink it.
questions.why: 「too ~ to부정사」는 「so ~ that + 주어 + couldn't」로 바꿔 쓴다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 한 단어를 쓰시오. He is rich enough to buy the car. = He is so rich ____ he can buy the car.
questions.why: 「형용사 + enough + to부정사」는 「so + 형용사 + that + 주어 + can」으로 바꾼다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 두 단어를 쓰시오. I set an alarm in order to wake up early. = I set an alarm ____ ____ I could wake up early.
questions.why: in order to는 목적의 so that절로 바꿔 쓸 수 있다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 in order to를 사용하여 같은 뜻의 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. (문장 전체를 쓸 것) She practices every day so that she can join the team.
questions.answer: She practices every day in order to join the team.
alt: She practices every day in order to join the team
questions.why: 「so that + 주어 + can + 동사원형」은 주어가 같을 때 「in order to + 동사원형」으로 줄여 쓸 수 있다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 한 단어를 쓰시오. It was such a boring class that I fell asleep. = The class was ____ boring that I fell asleep.
questions.why: 명사를 주어로 옮기면 「such + a + 형용사 + 명사」는 「so + 형용사」가 된다.

questions.stem: The scientist repeated the experiment several times ____ that she could get accurate results.
choices: so
such
very
too
as
questions.why: ‘~할 수 있도록’이라는 목적은 「so that + 주어 + could + 동사원형」으로 나타낸다.

questions.stem: The concert hall was ____ crowded that we had to stand at the back.
choices: so
such
such a
very
too
questions.why: 형용사 crowded 앞이므로 so를 쓴다. such 계열은 명사가 필요하고 too는 that절과 짝을 이루지 못한다.

questions.stem: It was ____ a moving speech that some people in the audience cried.
choices: so
such
very
too
quite
questions.why: 「a + 형용사 + 명사」 앞에는 such를 써서 「such + a(n) + 형용사 + 명사 + that」의 형태로 쓴다.

questions.stem: My grandmother writes down her passwords ____ she won't forget them.
choices: so that
such that
so as
in order
that so
questions.why: 뒤에 「주어 + won't + 동사원형」의 절이 오므로 목적의 접속사 so that이 알맞다.

questions.stem: The team practiced every morning ____ win the national championship.
choices: so that
in order to
so as
such as
in order
questions.why: 동사원형 win이 바로 뒤따르므로 「in order to + 동사원형」이 알맞다.

questions.stem: There was ____ little water in the bottle that we had to share it.
choices: so
such
very
too
few
questions.why: 「so little + 셀 수 없는 명사 + that」의 형태이다. few는 셀 수 있는 명사에 쓴다.

questions.stem: The instructions were ____ clearly written that even a child could follow them.
choices: so
such
such a
very
too
questions.why: 부사 clearly 앞이므로 「so + 부사 + that」의 so를 쓴다.

questions.stem: He put on sunscreen ____ as to protect his skin from the strong sun.
choices: so
such
in
that
for
questions.why: ‘~하기 위해서’를 뜻하는 「so as to + 동사원형」이 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: They are ____ close friends that they can share anything with each other.
choices: so
such
such a
very
too
questions.why: 복수명사 friends 앞이므로 관사 없이 「such + 형용사 + 복수명사 + that」을 쓴다.

questions.stem: Dad turned down the volume ____ the neighbors would not complain.
choices: so that
such that
so as
in order
as that
questions.why: ‘~하지 않도록’이라는 목적을 나타내는 절이므로 so that을 쓴다.

questions.stem: It was ____ terrible weather that the flight was canceled.
choices: so
such
such a
very
too
questions.why: weather는 셀 수 없는 명사이므로 관사 없이 「such + 형용사 + 명사 + that」으로 쓴다.

questions.stem: The runner was ____ exhausted that he could hardly stand up after the race.
choices: so
such
such an
very
too
questions.why: 형용사 exhausted 앞이므로 so를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장의 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말은? (1) It was ____ a strange story that nobody believed it. (2) They made ____ rapid progress that their teacher was surprised.
choices: so
such
very
too
much
questions.why: (1)은 「a + 형용사 + 명사」, (2)는 셀 수 없는 명사 progress 앞의 「형용사 + 명사」이므로 둘 다 such를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장의 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말은? (1) The wind blew ____ hard that the umbrella turned inside out. (2) I have ____ many things to do that I don't know where to start.
choices: so
such
very
too
quite
questions.why: (1)은 「so + 부사 + that」, (2)는 「so many + 복수명사 + that」이므로 둘 다 so이다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은? (A) The lecture was ____ boring that half the class fell asleep. (B) It was ____ an exciting final that nobody left early.
choices: so – such
such – so
so – so
such – such
very – such
questions.why: (A)는 형용사 앞이므로 so, (B)는 「an + 형용사 + 명사」 앞이므로 such이다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은? (A) She spoke in a low voice ____ that only I could hear her. (B) He goes jogging every morning ____ order to stay in shape.
choices: so – in
so – so
in – so
such – in
as – in
questions.why: (A)는 목적의 so that, (B)는 「in order to + 동사원형」이므로 so – in이 알맞다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장의 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말은? (1) He worked overtime ____ that he could finish the report on time. (2) The band played ____ well that the crowd asked for an encore.
choices: so
such
very
too
as
questions.why: (1)은 목적의 so that, (2)는 「so + 부사 + that」으로 둘 다 so를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 하나는?
choices: It was ____ a valuable painting that they kept it in a safe.
They had ____ a wonderful time that they stayed one more night.
The room was ____ quiet that I could hear the clock ticking.
He told ____ a funny joke that everyone burst out laughing.
It was ____ a long flight that my legs hurt.
questions.why: ③만 형용사 quiet 앞이라 so가 들어가고, 나머지는 모두 「a + 형용사 + 명사」 앞이라 such가 들어간다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: The problem was so difficult that nobody could solved it.
She spoke so quietly that we could hardly hear her.
It was such exciting a game that we cheered loudly.
They left early so as they could get good seats.
There was such much traffic that we were late.
questions.why: ②는 「so + 부사 + that + 주어 + 동사」의 바른 형태이다. ①은 could solve, ③은 such an exciting game, ④는 so that they could, ⑤는 so much traffic으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
choices: I keep a diary so that I can remember special days.
It was such a hot summer that many people got sick.
The suitcase was so heavy that I asked for help.
He whispered in order that nobody to hear him.
They sang so beautifully that the judges gave them full marks.
questions.why: in order that 뒤에는 「주어 + 조동사 + 동사원형」의 절이 와야 하므로 in order that nobody would hear him으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장들 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: The soup was too salty that I couldn't finish it.
We arrived early in order to getting good seats.
It was such a windy day that the tent blew away.
She is so a talented pianist that she won the contest.
He ran fast so that he can catch the last bus yesterday.
questions.why: ③은 「such + a + 형용사 + 명사 + that」의 바른 형태이다. ①은 so salty, ②는 to get, ④는 such a talented pianist, ⑤는 과거시제에 맞춰 could로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장들 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: The film was so moving that I watched it three times.
They saved money in order to travel around Europe.
It was such nice weather that we ate lunch outside.
I put a note on the door so that my sister wouldn't miss it.
There were so much people in the store that I left.
questions.why: people은 셀 수 있는 명사의 복수이므로 so many people that으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 오류가 없는 것은?
choices: He spoke so fast that I couldn't catch a single word.
It was so a serious accident that the road was closed.
The bag was such expensive that I put it back.
We took a map so as we would not get lost.
She studies at night in order that finish her project.
questions.why: ①은 「so + 부사 + that」의 바른 형태이다. ②는 such a, ③은 so expensive, ④는 so that we would not, ⑤는 in order to finish로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 오류가 있는 것은?
choices: I turned off my phone so that I could concentrate.
The lake was so clear that we could see the bottom.
It was such an honest answer that everyone respected him.
He is such kind that all his classmates like him.
We started early in order to avoid the rush hour.
questions.why: ④는 형용사 kind만 있으므로 such가 아니라 so kind that으로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 정확한 것은?
choices: There was so little time that we had to run to the gate.
The concert was such loud that my ears hurt.
He wore glasses so that see the board better.
It was so an old building that they tore it down.
She practiced hard so as to she could win.
questions.why: ①은 「so little + 셀 수 없는 명사 + that」의 바른 형태이다. ②는 so loud, ③은 so that he could see, ④는 such an old building, ⑤는 so that she could win으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 어법상 틀린 것을 고르시오.
choices: The teacher spoke slowly so that the new student could follow.
It was such a difficult question that even the teacher paused.
The rain was so heavy that the game was called off.
They are so good friends that they never fight.
He left a message in order to let us know.
questions.why: ④는 「형용사 + 복수명사」 앞이므로 such good friends that으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 자연스러운 것은?
choices: I hid the gift so that my brother wouldn't find it.
The box was too big that it didn't fit in my bag.
It was such cold morning that the windows froze.
She sang so beautiful that we all clapped.
They ran in order that catching the train.
questions.why: ①은 ‘~하지 않도록’의 so that절이 바르다. ②는 so big, ③은 such a cold morning, ④는 so beautifully, ⑤는 in order to catch로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 잘못된 것은?
choices: I saved the file so that I would not lose my work.
There was so much noise that I couldn't hear the announcement.
It was such an amazing view that we took many pictures.
He is so strong that he can lift the box alone.
The test was such easy that everyone got a perfect score.
questions.why: ⑤는 형용사 easy만 있으므로 so easy that으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 틀린 것을 고르시오.
choices: The show was <u>so</u> popular that tickets sold out in a day.
It was such <u>an</u> unusual name that I wrote it down.
We left early <u>so that</u> we could beat the traffic.
There was <u>such</u> heavy rain that the road flooded.
He was <u>so</u> a careful driver that he never had an accident.
questions.why: ⑤는 「a + 형용사 + 명사」 앞이므로 such a careful driver로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 각 문장의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: She smiled <u>so</u> brightly that everyone felt happy.
I bought two tickets <u>in order to</u> take my sister.
The room was <u>such</u> messy that I cleaned it right away.
They were <u>so</u> tired that they fell asleep on the bus.
It was such <u>a</u> long line that we gave up.
questions.why: ③은 형용사 messy만 있으므로 so messy that으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 잘못된 것은?
choices: He got a part-time job <u>so that</u> he could pay for the trip.
The story was <u>so</u> touching that I read it twice.
It was <u>such</u> a windy night that the power went out.
We took an early flight <u>so as</u> arrive before noon.
There was <u>so</u> little snow that the ski resort closed.
questions.why: so as 뒤에는 to부정사가 와야 하므로 so as to arrive로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: The coach shouted <u>so that</u> the players could hear him.
It was <u>such</u> good news that we celebrated all evening.
The suitcase was <u>too</u> heavy that I couldn't lift it.
She spoke <u>so</u> politely that nobody got angry.
He studies at night <u>in order to</u> keep up with his classmates.
questions.why: too는 that절이 아니라 to부정사와 짝을 이루므로 so heavy that으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 고쳐야 할 것은?
choices: I wrote it in big letters <u>so that</u> everyone could read it.
It was <u>such</u> a boring lecture that I nearly fell asleep.
There were <u>so</u> many questions that we ran out of time.
The water was <u>so</u> cold that nobody went swimming.
They practiced hard <u>in order that</u> winning the game.
questions.why: in order that 뒤에는 절이 와야 하므로 in order to win 또는 in order that they could win으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 쓰임이 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: The bakery smells <u>so</u> good that I stop by every day.
He locked the door <u>so that</u> nobody could get in.
It was <u>such an</u> honest mistake that we forgave him.
There were <u>such</u> many dishes on the table that we couldn't finish them.
She ran <u>so as to</u> catch the last subway.
questions.why: many 앞에는 such를 쓰지 않으므로 so many dishes that으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 그 소년은 너무 어려서 혼자 여행할 수 없었다.
choices: The boy was so young that he could travel alone.
The boy was so young that he couldn't travel alone.
The boy was such young that he couldn't travel alone.
The boy was too young that he couldn't travel alone.
The boy was so a young that he couldn't travel alone.
questions.why: ‘너무 어려서 ~할 수 없었다’는 「so + 형용사 + that + 주어 + couldn't」로 쓴다. ①은 뜻이 반대이다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 그녀는 시험에 합격하기 위해 도서관에서 공부했다.
choices: She studied at the library so that she pass the exam.
She studied at the library so as pass the exam.
She studied at the library in order to pass the exam.
She studied at the library in order that pass the exam.
She studied at the library for pass the exam.
questions.why: 목적은 「in order to + 동사원형」으로 나타낸다. ①은 so that she could pass, ②는 so as to pass가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 그것은 아주 감동적인 이야기여서 많은 독자들이 눈물을 흘렸다.
choices: It was so a touching story that many readers cried.
It was such touching story that many readers cried.
It was such a touching story that many readers cried.
It was very touching story that many readers cried.
It was too touching story that many readers cried.
questions.why: 「such + a(n) + 형용사 + 명사 + that」이 바른 어순이다. so는 명사구를 꾸밀 수 없다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 나는 늦지 않도록 알람을 두 개 맞췄다.
choices: I set two alarms so that I would not be late.
I set two alarms so that not be late.
I set two alarms in order that not to be late.
I set two alarms so as I would not be late.
I set two alarms such that not being late.
questions.why: ‘~하지 않도록’은 「so that + 주어 + would not + 동사원형」으로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 교통 체증이 너무 심해서 우리는 회의에 늦었다.
choices: There was such heavy traffic that we were late for the meeting.
There was so heavy traffic that we were late for the meeting.
There was such a heavy traffic that we were late for the meeting.
There was too heavy traffic that we were late for the meeting.
There was so a heavy traffic that we were late for the meeting.
questions.why: traffic은 셀 수 없는 명사이므로 관사 없이 「such + 형용사 + 명사 + that」으로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 그는 모두가 들을 수 있도록 크게 말했다.
choices: He spoke loudly so that everyone could hear him.
He spoke loudly so that everyone hear him.
He spoke loudly so as everyone could hear him.
He spoke loudly in order that hearing him.
He spoke so loudly that everyone couldn't hear him.
